# One CAD transaction touching an account kept to the thousandth and an
# ordinary one kept to the cent. Both splits are legal figures and the entry
# balances exactly — 12.00 out, 12.00 in.
#
# The values GnuCash stores carry the two accounts' own denominators, so a
# balance check that adds bare numerators sees 12000 against -1200 and calls a
# correct entry unbalanced.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fuel
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	commodity_scu: 1000

2026-02-01 * "Fuel, billed to the cent and held to the thousandth"
	Expenses:Fuel 12.00 CAD
	Assets:Bank -12.00 CAD
